developer_context.problem_scenario: A logout route attempts to expire an authentication session token on the client browser.
developer_context.observable_behavior: Supplying conflicting expiration or max-age parameter overrides causes the browser cookie deletion header to fail.
developer_context.expected_outcome: The cookie deletion utility should overwrite expiration headers so client browsers reliably delete the designated cookie.
developer_context.environmental_context: HTTP Set-Cookie header generation and session teardown.
